full_name: Zia Haider Rahman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Walter Jackson Bate Fellow Independent Writer
bio: Zia Haider Rahman is the author of the novel In the Light of What We Know (Farrar, Straus and Giroux, 2014). His writing has appeared in the Guardian, the New York Times, and elsewhere.
